common_conditions.example: The Applicant shall comply with all comments in the Board Engineer's review letter dated August 29, 2024 and the Board Planner's review letter dated August 30, 2024, except as modified by the testimony at the hearing.

The Applicant shall obtain all required outside agency approvals, including but not limited to the Somerset-Union Soil Conservation District, the County Planning Board and the Township Municipal Utilities Authority.
The Applicant shall submit revised plans incorporating the conditions of this approval for review and approval by the Board Engineer prior to the signing of the plans.
The Applicant shall provide a 50-foot landscaped buffer with evergreen plantings along the residential property line, as shown on the revised landscape plan.
The Applicant shall post performance guarantees and inspection fees in accordance with Section 190-70 of the Township Code prior to the issuance of any construction permits.
All site lighting shall be full cutoff and shall not exceed 0.5 foot-candles at any property line.
The Applicant shall pay all outstanding escrow fees and taxes prior to the release of the signed plans.
